# Third-party dataset: deepset/prompt-injections

- Source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/deepset/prompt-injections (revision `4f61ecb038e9c3fb77e21034b22511b523772cdd`)
- License: Apache-2.0 (as tagged on the dataset page). Converted from parquet to JSONL unchanged (fields `text`, `label`; 1 = injection).
- Splits: train 546 rows (203 injections), test 116 rows (60 injections). Contains English and German text.
- This repo did not author this data; credit to its publishers.
